record_body:
Account summary
- Arcadia Search is an embeddings-heavy team evaluating Redwood Hosted API for query-time + batch indexing embeddings.
- Primary goal: reduce p95 latency + unit cost vs current provider while keeping “boring reliability.”
- This account is one of the cohorts targeted by the lifecycle onboarding work: email CTAs pointed to the Embeddings Quickstart + “first request” flow.

ICP / fit
- Strong fit for Hosted API + Optimize guidance (batching/caching + cost/latency visibility).
- They care about: predictable p95, throttling behavior, and “what happens when you’re at capacity?” (fallback story).

Use case details (from notes/calls)
- Workload: embeddings for semantic search.
  - ~70% query-time embeddings (short inputs, high concurrency during business hours)
  - ~30% batch indexing (longer inputs, can run overnight)
- Also exploring reranking later, but embeddings is the immediate blocker for their roadmap.
- They are testing both English-only and multilingual (Spanish + German) content; asked specifically if we have a recommended multilingual embedding model.

Technical requirements / constraints
- Latency: wants p95 query-time embedding < 120ms at steady state (they quoted ~180–240ms today depending on region).
- Throughput: initial target ~25–40 RPS query-time; batch indexing up to 2–5M docs/month.
- Cost sensitivity: high. Quote: “embeddings bill is the thing finance notices.”
- SDK preference: TypeScript in production; Python used for offline pipelines.
- Wants clear retry/backoff guidance and explicit rate limits (what’s hard vs soft).

Security / compliance
- Requested: SOC 2 report, SSO/SAML for console, audit logging for API key actions, retention controls.
- Data handling: ok with public cloud, but asked about log retention + ability to disable payload logging.

Pilot / evaluation notes
- Pilot objective: confirm end-to-end search quality doesn’t regress while reducing cost and improving p95.
- Current plan (proposed): 2-week pilot
  - Week 1: integrate query-time embeddings behind feature flag; capture latency + cost dashboards; compare against baseline provider.
  - Week 2: run batch indexing slice + relevance eval on golden query set.
- They asked for a “Redwood-recommended setup” (model choice + batch size) rather than experimenting from scratch.

Activation + onboarding notes (relevant to lifecycle sprint)
- They came in via onboarding email CTA to Embeddings Quickstart.
- 2025-01-21: user reported a link from email landing in an older console route (404). Logged as SUP-2841; resolved by updating redirect + UTM mapping.
- After fix, they completed first successful embeddings request same day.
- Still some confusion around where to see token/cost breakdown for embeddings specifically (they expected an “embeddings cost” card; guided them to the usage dashboard filters).

Activity timeline (most recent first)
- 2025-02-03: Email follow-up from Avery: proposed pilot plan + asked for golden query set format + target languages. Waiting on Arcadia to confirm model shortlist.
- 2025-01-29: Technical call (Fireflies ff_905487) w/ Arcadia eng lead + Aparna. Reviewed batching guidance, recommended request sizes, and how to interpret p95 in console.
- 2025-01-24: Shared security FAQ + SOC 2 link (Drive stub) and answered retention question: “Can we limit payload logging?”
- 2025-01-21: Support issue re: onboarding email link 404 (SUP-2841). Workaround provided same day; fix shipped next day.
- 2025-01-16: Initial discovery call (Fireflies ff_905112). Key quote: “We’re not looking for a fancy platform; we just need embeddings that are fast and cheap with fewer surprises.”
- 2025-01-09: Inbound signup + first usage spike (embeddings tests from TS).

Open questions (to close in next touch)
- Which embedding dimensionality do they need to standardize on? (They asked about migration cost if dims change.)
- Region: where are their end users concentrated (NA/EU split)? They mentioned EU traffic but didn’t quantify.
- What is their current provider’s throttling behavior (to benchmark Redwood’s)?

Internal notes / guidance
- Keep messaging grounded; don’t over-promise on “best latency” without pointing to benchmark methodology.
- This account is sensitive to onboarding friction. Ensure future email CTAs use the corrected console path and embeddings quickstart URL.
- If they expand to reranking, likely a Dedicated conversation in Q2 (but currently scoped to Hosted API).

Next steps
- Avery: send 2-week pilot plan (including success criteria: p95, cost per 1k embeddings, relevance deltas on golden set).
- Aparna: provide “recommended batching + retry defaults” snippet for TS + Python.
- Arcadia: share golden query set + confirm languages + confirm target p95 and RPS assumptions.
- If security answers accepted: schedule procurement intro + confirm forecast close month (tentatively 2025-03).
